study: Training-neighbor transfer from cross-modal canonical coordinates into original ViT-H/14 image-embedding directions; sub-04 single-person development and conditional official high-repeat stress test.
context: Historical multi-view R80 CCA recognized 65/200 in its evaluation-only canonical photo gallery and used a 1012-object fit. No query photographs, held captions or true-word gallery enter the new decoder. The existing class-prior, neural-image likelihood and global-angle methods did not perform native H14 kernel smoothing over photographs in the allowed training bank. The present 128 generic classes have four real presentations per photo and have powered previous experiments, including selection of the historical rank-32 readout. They remain entirely outside fitting, neighbor selection and angle calibration in this experiment.
split: Historical official-repeat extended universe of 1012 minus all 128 held generic classes gives exactly 884 training objects, 8840 photos. Retain all 128 held classes and 1280 distinct development queries for the final score. No official query or official test gallery opens unless the generic gate passes. No image is generated in the development screen.
estimator: Reuse the historical sub-04 posterior EEG standardization and regularized CCA (EEG 0.5, image 0.25 of mean spectral variance), multiply each side by square roots of the canonical correlations, and cosine-normalize the first 32 coordinates. Rank original 8840 training photos by cross-modal cosine to the EEG query. Softmax the K closest with temperature 0.08. Compute their weighted mean of unit native H14 vectors, convert it to a unit tangent at the mean training-image axis and blend it with the unit native-ridge tangent. Normalize the blended direction and restore exactly the recipient native global-calibrated angle. Keep the native tangent if a prior has zero tangent or the blend vanishes. Word decoding is separate and fixed.
training: Permute only 884 sorted training IDs using NumPy seed 260571 and split into four whole-object folds. In each, use 663 objects for CCA, native ridge and neighbor bank, 221 disjoint objects as queries. Pool only these 884-object OOF examples to compute global gain = median true original angle / median native estimated angle, cap = 95th percentile true angle. Apply those fixed scalars to every controlled arm, including the final 128 classes. The historical value 3.2474 used 64 of the current evaluation objects and is not used. Evaluate the preset grid K in [8,32,128] and blend fraction [.25,.50,.75]. Among settings whose training-OOF within-ten hits and mean target cosine each meet or exceed the angle-only control, choose highest OOF mean 2210-photo reciprocal rank, break ties by overall within-ten hits, cosine, smaller K and smaller mixing fraction. If no grid point qualifies, take highest OOF mean reciprocal rank by the same tie rule, flag that no training setting cleared the constraints, and still score the fixed choice once. No choice uses the 128 evaluation classes.
controls: Same recipient calibrated angle with native ridge only; one best canonical neighbor mixed at the selected fraction; same K/weights with native training feature identities permuted, fixed seed 260572; swap only the learned local tangent with the next held photo of the same object, evaluation control with class membership only in donor assignment. Also report the constant native training mean. Mixing the uniform mean of all training vectors as a prior has zero tangent at this axis and equals angle-only by construction. All ranked development outputs use the same raw H14 gallery. Canonical retrieval is a reference only.
evaluation: After freezing OOF calibration and selection, seal directions from EEG before opening the 128-class original H14 gallery for evaluation. Primary endpoints are full 1280-photo top-one count and MRR; also report top5, within-object ten-photo top one, pairwise win rate versus nine same-object photos, and mean correct raw H14 cosine. Object-cluster paired 95% percentile bootstrap, 10000 draws, seed 260573. Advance only if the full-gallery top-one count increases, MRR gain versus angle-only has strictly positive lower 95% bound, mean target cosine and within-ten top1 are both nondecreasing, and matched within-class pair credit exceeds wrong-local-tangent point estimate. Otherwise stop without official generation.
possible_r80: On a positive gate, use the same 884 training objects, bank, selected K/temperature/mix and angle calibration for sub-04 official EEG four-repeat and 80-repeat views. For the requested three-arm high-budget rendering compare matched local, angle-only, and donor-local along the recipient ridge tangent, with exactly the existing EEG words, noise seed, radius and prompt per recipient. Never use target photos to choose a direction or sample. Previous 1012-fit results are historical references.
